subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Control UI for Multi-Agent + Subagent Orchestration (Hierarchy, Bulk Ops, and Scalability)

question: Should #52803 become a dedicated Mission Board/Orchestration route, an expanded Sessions/Tasks experience, or wait behind the broader dashboard/activity contracts before bulk controls are added?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the UI surface and privileged multi-run control semantics is a product and ownership decision that automation should not settle.

options.title: Stage read-only hierarchy first
options.body: Add a scalable hierarchy over existing session/task lineage and defer kill/steer/retry/cleanup controls to a later reviewed slice.

options.title: Fold into existing Sessions/Tasks
options.body: Avoid a new route and extend current pages only after maintainers define how hierarchy, filters, and bulk operations fit those surfaces.

options.title: Wait for dashboard/activity contracts
options.body: Defer this issue until dashboard status widgets and richer session activity semantics land, then implement against the accepted source of truth.

recommendation.title: Stage read-only hierarchy first
recommendation.body: Add a scalable hierarchy over existing session/task lineage and defer kill/steer/retry/cleanup controls to a later reviewed slice.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is the strongest UI/UX and dashboard-v2 routing signal for the Control UI surface decision, with session-runtime contributors available for backend semantics.
